title: Newmark Leads Leasing for 12 Seattle Office Buildings as Martin Selig Real Estate Restructures Nearly $500 Million in Debt
summary: Martin Selig Real Estate has completed modifications of loans totaling nearly $500 million on 12 Seattle office buildings, enhancing its ability to sign new leases and renewals in all 12.
